name: aether-tools
description: Repository-level scripts (token sync, invariant gates). Deliberately NOT an npm workspace: every import of packages/ui is a relative path, so workspaces bought nothing here, and a workspace root without its own lockfile makes `npm ci` fail for both apps — npm walks to the root, ignores the committed apps/*/package-lock.json, and reports EUSAGE. The frontends install and pin independently.
